text: Figure 6.14: Information path for the write verification error The NVRAM Block written to NV memory is immediately read back and compared with the original content in RAM (1). If the verification fails, NVM_E_VERIFY_FAILED error is reported to the DEM, and recovery is initiated with write retries if configured (2). If the recovery fails (3), the NVRAM manager reports NVM_E_REQ_FAILED error to the DEM and sets the job result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK (4), see NVM API request failure.
